name: Benchmark_SDWB_deltaE
description: Benchmark_SDWB_deltaE evaluates perceptual color fidelity of image outputs by measuring ΔE (deltaE) color differences between generated/processed images and reference images. It is intended to quantify color shifts and consistency introduced by image generation, editing, or post‑processing methods, reporting aggregate deltaE statistics across test cases. The benchmark is useful for comparing models on color accuracy and visual fidelity.
reputation: A niche, specialist benchmark used by researchers focused on color fidelity and image quality; limited mainstream adoption.
